regions.today: Generally dry this evening with sunny spells, in moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Dry with clear spells tonight in light to moderate southerly winds. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 9 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Wednesday will be a cloudy day, but generally dry and mild, just a few patches of light rain or drizzle. It will be rather windy however, with fresh to strong southerly winds. Highest temperatures of 15 to 17 degrees. Rain will gradually spread from the west through the late evening into Wednesday night.
